provenanceRules: Each archived status is retained as originally recorded.
Later real-network successes supplement but do not rewrite earlier NOT_RUN records.
PASS of a scoped probe is not full UI, broad device, 16KB-runtime, or 8-hour stability acceptance.
Original evidence references are local archive identifiers with hashes, not repository-relative download links.
Raw device identifiers, credentials, addresses, network handles and machine paths are not exported.
